newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: DRB-Hicom says stocks to requote Monday.
newsitem.headline: DRB-Hicom says stocks to requote Monday.

text.p: DRB-Hicom group said on Thursday that all nine stocks of companies linked to the late Yahaya Ahmad will be requoted on Monday.

"Immediately after the press conference this afternoon, the company secretary of the seven companies plus the other two companies will be submitting a request to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange for the upliftment of trading which will resume on Monday, March 10," said the group's new chairman Saleh Sulong.

The nine stocks are national carmaker Perusahaan Otomobil Nasional Bhd, vehicle assembler Diversified Resources Bhd (DRB), heavy industrial firm Hicom Holdings Bhd, diversified Gadek (Malaysia) Bhd, timber products concern Golden Pharos Bhd, cement maker Kedah Cement Holdings Bhd, car distributor Edaran Otomobil Nasional Bhd, financial firm Gadek Capital Bhd, and diversified Eastern Pacific Industrial Corp Bhd.
The group on Tuesday suspended trading in the stocks following news of Yahaya's death in a helicopter crash on Monday night.
